command: set -u; echo '=== ID ==='; hostname; whoami; date -Is; echo '=== VM EPOCH ==='; systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p ActiveState -p MainPID -p ActiveEnterTimestamp --no-pager; echo '=== WRITERS ==='; for p in /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/agentzero/consciousness.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/agentzero/unified.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/frank/db/amygdala.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/frank/db/world_experience.db /var/lib/entityos/data/unified.db; do echo "--- $p"; sudo -n lsof -Fn -- "$p" 2>/dev/null | head -80 || true; done; echo '=== VOLATILE SCHEMAS ==='; for p in /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/agentzero/consciousness.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/agentzero/unified.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/frank/db/amygdala.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/frank/db/world_experience.db; do echo "--- $p"; sudo -n sqlite3 "file:$p?mode=ro" "PRAGMA quick_check; SELECT name||'|'||type FROM sqlite_master WHERE type IN ('table','view') ORDER BY name;" 2>&1 | head -200; done; echo '=== TARGETED ROW COUNTS ==='; for spec in '/var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/agentzero/consciousness.db|consciousness_events' '/var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/agentzero/unified.db|dopamine_state' '/var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/agentzero/unified.db|reward_log' '/var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/frank/db/world_experience.db|personality_state' '/var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/frank/db/world_experience.db|identity_snapshot'; do p=${spec%%|*}; t=${spec#*|}; n=$(sudo -n sqlite3 "file:$p?mode=ro" "SELECT count(*) FROM \"$t\";" 2>/dev/null || echo NA); echo "$p|$t|$n"; done; echo '=== DURABLE TABLE CANDIDATES ==='; sudo -n sqlite3 'file:/var/lib/entityos/data/unified.db?mode=ro' "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND (lower(name) LIKE '%conscious%' OR lower(name) LIKE '%person%' OR lower(name) LIKE '%identity%' OR lower(name) LIKE '%experience%' OR lower(name) LIKE '%amyg%' OR lower(name) LIKE '%dopamine%' OR lower(name) LIKE '%reward%') ORDER BY name;" 2>&1 | head -300; echo '=== VOICE DB PATH SOURCES ==='; sudo -n grep -R -n -E 'consciousness\.db|world_experience\.db|amygdala\.db|unified\.db|expanduser\(' /var/lib/entityos/voice --include='*.py' 2>/dev/null | head -240; echo '=== ROOTFS DB MTIMES/HASH ==='; for p in /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/agentzero/consciousness.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/agentzero/unified.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/frank/db/amygdala.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/frank/db/world_experience.db; do sudo -n stat -c '%n|%s|%y' "$p"; sudo -n sha256sum "$p"; done
